documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in regional logistics. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer is an existing user in regional logistics who is experiencing workflow disruption due to a configuration change. Their current priority is resolving this issue, and they explicitly request that support be involved before any discussion of expansion. This is identified as a support incident, not a sales or discovery opportunity.

claims.quote: Please get support involved before discussing expansion.

raw_proposal.draft: We have noted that your workflow has stopped following a configuration change, and we understand that your immediate priority is to resolve this issue. As requested, we will escalate this to our support team for assistance. Please allow them to address the disruption before any further discussions about expansion or additional features.
questions: What specific configuration change caused the workflow disruption?
Have you already contacted the support team, or would you like us to escalate this to them directly?
uncertainties: The exact nature of the configuration change is unknown.
The current status of the support escalation is not confirmed.
